name: Marcilla (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Marcilla (a castle on blue within a bordure of the chains of Navarre).
history: Municipal flag of Marcilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
